items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: The changes would be between George Wettling and Cliff Leeman and we had several bass players - changes of bass players in there.

ctx.x: This was after he and Louie -- after Louie had gone out on his own---
Oh, yes--- well, I remember once being in the Sunset when King Oliver came in and I remember the night very well; I was with - it may have been George Wettling-----
